title: Present simple: habits and facts
point: Use the present simple for things you do regularly and things that are generally true; add -s for he, she and it.

sentences.ja: 私は毎朝コーヒーを飲みます。
sentences.note: "Have" is the everyday verb for meals and drinks; "drink coffee" is fine but sounds more literal.

sentences.ja: 姉は銀行で働いています。
sentences.text: My sister works at a bank.
sentences.note: A permanent job takes the present simple, even though the Japanese says 〜ています.

sentences.ja: 近所のスーパーは夜11時に閉まります。
sentences.text: The supermarket near us closes at eleven.

sentences.ja: 彼は辛い食べ物を食べません。
このバスは駅に行きますか？
sentences.text: Does this bus go to the station?

sentences.ja: 私たちは週に二回ジムに行きます。
sentences.text: We go to the gym twice a week.

sentences.ja: 毎週月曜の朝にチームミーティングがあります。
sentences.text: We have a team meeting every Monday morning.

sentences.ja: 図書館は日曜日は開いていません。
sentences.text: The library isn't open on Sundays.

sentences.ja: 普段は何時に寝ますか？
sentences.text: What time do you usually go to bed?
sentences.note: "Sleep" is the state; "go to bed" is the moment you turn in.

sentences.ja: うちの猫は一日中寝ています。
